reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent short mission with strong feedback and accessible controls; limited free navigation and continuous-control evidence, cramped portrait combat view.
reasons.controls: Large FIRE, MOVE, AIM and DASH worked in sampled batches, including two-contact patrol combat. Zoom and drag are usable here, but pause lifecycle and contact releases prevent a real held-control comfort judgment.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coils and uplink create understandable progression; patrol engagements and cover response observed. Heavy route/tap assistance and short paused bursts leave depth, tension and sustained enjoyment only partly assessed.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber visual identity, rainy industrial scene and polished title/result layout; some dark geometry and distant targets blend together. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Objective checkmarks, contextual HOLD labels, route lines, map legend, target-down and coil OFF feedback reduce uncertainty. Map closes visibly. No settings changes were needed.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and large controls are clear at 390x844. Small distant enemies, small status text, dark cover and stacked prompts reduce scene legibility.
